CHROMIUM: proc: uid_cputime: Store kuid in hash Storing tasks by mapped user IDs doesn't make sense in a system with more than one user namespace. Storing kuids keeps the output consistent, preventing different users running in separate namespaces from being added together. Also this stop leaking all namespace IDs to each reader of the proc file. BUG=b/31150071 TEST=cat /proc/uid_cputime/show_uid_stat from a user namespace Change-Id: I511cee901ef9a4c5211694cfa65c10bc77c3f339 Signed-off-by: Dylan Reid <dgreid@chromium.org> Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/377688 Reviewed-by: Guenter Roeck <groeck@chromium.org>

CHROMIUM: arm64: dts: assign a clock rate to VOP dclk The VOP dclk should be enabled before writing registers, otherwise the VOP will be blocked, all of the registers setting will not take effect. This dclk is enabld in default value of register, and the core-boot or u-boot may also enable it. But that can not guarantee dclk always be enabled before vop_initialil. In RK3399, the dclk's parent is setted to VPLL by default, but this VPLL probably be turned off before vop_initialil, that cause nothing output from VOP. Assign a rate to the vop dclk, can make sure this dclk get a valid parent and a good clock rate to make all of the registers writing take effect. BUG=chrome-os-partner:53565 TEST=eDP works without Type-C DP connection, when the cdn-dp is enabled in dts. Change-Id: Ic53c762032e76714f14edb7ea10492648053b331 Signed-off-by: Yakir Yang <ykk@rock-chips.com> Signed-off-by: Chris Zhong <zyw@rock-chips.com> Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/374262 Reviewed-by: Derek Basehore <dbasehore@chromium.org>

cr50: mark updated image as good once a usb request is received There is now a call to reset the retry counter before the hard reset after an update. Cr50 will use the updated image for the next 5 boots, but on the 6th it sees the retry counter is greater than 5 and then jumps back to the old image. Cr50 needs to call system_process_retry_counter to reset the counter and corrupt the old image header to prevent falling back to the old image. Normally the reset counter would be processed after it receives a TPM command. Reef does not have Cr50 TPM support. Until Cr50 has TPM support for Reef, Cr50 should have a different point to know when the update is good. This change adds a board property to mark the process the reset counter once the Cr50 USB controller receives a set address request from the host. On Reef the controller defaults to the AP PHY when suzyq is not connected, so it should have a connection to the AP or through suzyq after boot. The board property is only added to Reef. Behavior on Kevin and Gru is unchanged. BUG=chrome-os-partner:56864 BRANCH=none TEST=update reef. Wait until Cr50 prints 'SETAD' then run 'rw 0x4000012c' and verify it is reset to 0. Change-Id: If517202f25a694cd70550e3be047ea502e7c5383 Signed-off-by: Mary Ruthven <mruthven@chromium.org> Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/380354

CHROMIUM: mesh: send avg rx mesh beacon signal strength in station dump There are 2 parts of this: 1. calculate the average received mesh beacon signal strength per peer.
